about: Wallet-provider lane falsifiers merged by tasks 010 and 004 (PRs #62 and #63). WP01 restores a temp-directory fallback when base_path is missing, WP02 accepts an empty root the same way, and WP03 replaces the non-absolute refusal with the same temp fallback; the named storage-root test then fails in each case. WP04 replaces the profile's `(deny default)` with `(allow default)`, and WP05 appends `(allow network*)` beside the profile's existing `(deny network*)`; those are the two profile falsifiers proven by task 004. A falsifier counts as caught only when every named test fails. Unit-test names of the form `tests::<module>::<fn>` resolve under `src/tests/` and must be registered in the unit test executable; bare integration-test names resolve against `tests/confine.rs`, which is a separate binary. File paths are relative to the repository root. This list records the three storage-root refusals and the two profile mutations above; CONFINEMENT.md also documents a sibling-read allowance, an appended `(allow default)`, and a removed storage-root write rule, which are not registered here yet. The remaining step is wiring the shared examples/agent-host/falsify.py runner to accept the wallet command and run each named test with --exact.

falsifiers.title: a missing storage root falls back to a temp directory instead of refusing
an empty storage root is accepted instead of refused
a relative storage root is accepted instead of refused
the profile allows every operation by default
the profile adds a network allow beside its explicit network denial
